logo.description: Wordmark 'OFFLIMITS' with a two-upward-arrows mark called 'The Untold' — left arrow = the gear provided to athletes, right arrow = the athlete's motivation/belief; aligned, they represent limitless potential. Primary red brand color.

business_description: Indian D2C sports and athleisure brand selling performance footwear and apparel — running, gym/training, basketball and lifestyle shoes, plus tracksuits, hoodies, sweatshirts, sweatpants and tees — at value-for-money price points. Products are designed for Indian weather and lifestyles and built with in-house comfort/performance technologies (Advance Memory Foam, Athlite®, Flexinit®, Glovefit®, Wiktech®). Launched by Gurukirpa Lifestyle Company, a large Indian sportswear manufacturer/exporter; OFFLIMITS produces ~2M apparel pieces and ~1M pairs of shoes a year, sold via its own site, leading multi-brand stores, exclusive branded stores (Zirakpur, Ambala) and exported to the US, Europe, Australia and UAE.
business_model: D2C ecommerce (Shopify) on offlimits.co.in, plus wholesale/multi-brand retail distribution and company-owned exclusive stores; backed by owned manufacturing (Gurukirpa Lifestyle Company).
brand_aesthetic: Bold, energetic, streetwear-meets-performance. Motivational, athlete-first tone; 'push beyond limits' visual language.

brand_voice.description: Motivational, gutsy, inclusive, and value-conscious. Speaks to everyday athletes and fitness enthusiasts ('the OFF LIMITS Tribe'), emphasizing defying limits, affordability of high performance, and made-in-India credibility.
voice_patterns: Value + performance together ('International standards at value-for-money price points')

brand_values: Accessible high performance (affordable performance gear for athletes who can't buy premium brands)
Made in India, designed for Indian conditions

primary: Value-seeking Indian fitness enthusiasts and everyday athletes (men & women)
Runners, gym-goers, and basketball/sport players wanting performance shoes without premium prices
